sentences.en: The astronauts were greeted by their enthusiastic cheers and applause.
sentences.zh: 宇航员们受到了他们热情的欢呼和掌声的欢迎。

sentences.en: He pretends to be enthusiastic when his boss is around.
sentences.zh: 他老板在的时候他就装出一副热心的样子。

sentences.en: This book is a result of his enthusiastic research.
sentences.zh: 这本书是他热衷研究的结果。

senses.zh: 热情的，热心的；充满热情的，热切的
